Weighted average number of common shares outstanding 10,238 9,931 10,256 9,931

NOTE: Medical Assurance Inc said operating earnings exclude the after-tax effect of capital gains and losses. The company, however, was not immediately available to discuss its capital gains and losses.

Results for 1997 include the operations of MOMED Holding Co, the parent company of Missouri Medical Insurance Co, which was acquired by Medical Assurance in December 1996. The increase in revenue for the second quarter of 1997 was attributable to MOMED.
Earnings per share are calculated as if the shares issued as a result of the December 1996 stock dividend were outstanding throughout 1996.
Through the first six months of 1997, the company said it purchased 51,300 shares of its stock.
